bio: The mask fused to Ganbuku saved her life, but stole it, too. Her Dynasty is ruled by “the bearer of the mask,” and Ganbuku was sent to retrieve it, not use it – but in the end only the strength of the mask could save her. She never wished to rule her people, but now she's too powerful to do anything less.
